qc.label_under_test: The word ' a' (or the word in that same slot: ' to' in 'a sight to', ' real' in 'a real') right where a sentence is about to state a thing's acclaim or standing ('was always a', 'has become a', 'is considered to be a', 'a sight to', 'became a National Historic Landmark'); it fires on that setup word whatever noun follows; quiet on everyday 'a' (bought a bag, is a tall man, named after a farmer). Also fires on the name piece ' Belt' in 'Atlanta BeltLine'.

neighbours.label: In English prose, the setup word just before a sentence delivers praise or lasting standing for a thing: ' a' in 'has become a / is regarded as a / nothing short of a', ' to' in 'a sight to' / 'to die for', ' real' in 'a real'; fires on the setup word whatever noun follows, quiet when the same frame leads to a negative or mundane noun (nightmare, threat, short walk).
fire: Over the past two decades, the small harbor town has become a beloved destination for painters and poets.
The cathedral's restored rose window is a sight to behold at sunset.
Her debut novel is widely regarded as a masterpiece of modern American fiction.
The team's comeback in the final minutes was nothing short of a miracle.
The chocolate cake at that little bakery is to die for.
This old cast-iron skillet is a real treasure, and it cooks better than anything I own.
Since its release, the film has become a classic that families return to every winter.
The bridge is considered a triumph of nineteenth-century engineering.
quiet: Over the past two decades, the small harbor town has become a nightmare for commuters and delivery drivers.
The cathedral's closed side entrance is a short walk from the bus stop.
Her debut novel is widely regarded as a failure of plotting and pacing.
The team's collapse in the final minutes was nothing short of a disaster.
The chocolate cake at that little bakery is too dry and overpriced.
This old cast-iron skillet is a real pain, and it rusts faster than anything I own.
Since its release, the app has become a threat to the privacy of families everywhere.
The bridge is considered a hazard by the county's road inspectors.

predictions: Expect about 5-6/8 fire to clear 0.20; a risk is that the model cannot see the noun yet at ' a', so negative near misses (same setup word, 'has become a', 'a real') will score close to fire items and sink AUROC.
